summary: Corrected one-card GMM2 with W4A8 bias and GMM1-produced input/scale: four samples median ~68us, main-memory read ~66MB, close to active packed W2 bytes and comparable order to Run107 live ~83us/layer. Together with Run148 GMM1, both are weight-read dominated at ~1TB/s effective counter rate. No demonstrated >=5ms safe GMM edit; pivot to DSA chain audit.
